The capital, split between $50 million in USDT and $50 million in RAIN tokens, positions Rain as the third largest prediction market globally by total value locked. Unlike centralised competitors, Rain operates as a fully decentralised, permissionless platform allowing developers, communities and AI agents to create prediction markets without centralised approval. The V2 protocol features an on-chain order book for enhanced liquidity and AI-powered systems for market creation and moderation.
